Label.Text: Excluded locations never hold progression items, keys or boss rewards: only rupees, ammo, hearts and the like (a map or compass may land there). A song or boss reward spot that can only hold a song or reward with your settings stays included (the log says so). Excluding very many locations can leave too little room for the required items; the error then says to exclude fewer. Pick a location to exclude it (click the field and type to search); double-click an excluded location to include it again. Scan the game on the ROM Options tab to fill the picker.

ListView.Name: excl_list
ListView.Tooltip: Double-click a location to include it again.

Label.Text: Keep a chosen item away from a chosen location: the seed puts that item somewhere else. Pick a location and an item (click a field and type to search), then click Forbid. A Progressive item (such as Progressive Bomb Bag) covers every tier of that upgrade, with Progressive Items on or off. Double-click a rule to remove it. Scan the game on the ROM Options tab to fill the item list.

Button.Tooltip: The item is never placed at the location.

ListView.Name: restrict_list
ListView.Tooltip: Double-click a rule to remove it.
